decl.text:
dbCreateArc(
d_cellView txl_layerPurposel_ellipse_bBox
l_arc_bBox
)
=> d_arc / nil

description.text:
Creates an arc.
The arc is determined by calculating the overlap or the interception between the ellipse and arc bBox given by the caller. In order to correctly determine the intersection of the given bBoxes, overlapping edges between the bBoxes are required.

items.name: d_cellView
items.desc: The cellview.

items.name: txl_layerPurpose
items.desc:
Name, number, or a list of layer or layer-purpose pair.
For more information, see Type txl_layerPurpose.

items.name: l_ellipse_bBox
items.desc: Bounding box of the ellipse containing the arc.

items.name: l_arc_bBox
items.desc: Bounding box of the arc.

arguments.text:
d_cellView
The cellview.
txl_layerPurpose
Name, number, or a list of layer or layer-purpose pair.
For more information, see Type txl_layerPurpose.
l_ellipse_bBox
Bounding box of the ellipse containing the arc.
l_arc_bBox
Bounding box of the arc.

items.desc: The dbObject of the arc.
The arc is not created.

returns.text:
d_arc
The dbObject of the arc.
nil
The arc is not created.

description.text: Creates an area blockage object of the type placement in the given cellview. Area blockages are used to prevent instances from being placed within a specific area.

items.name: d_cellviewId
items.desc: The database ID of the cellview.

items.name: l_points
items.desc:
Specifies the list of points for the blockage.
For more information, see Type l_point.

items.name: d_owner
items.desc:
Optional argument indicating the owner ID of the blockage.
Default is nil.

arguments.text:
d_cellviewId
The database ID of the cellview.
l_points
Specifies the list of points for the blockage.
For more information, see Type l_point.
d_owner
Optional argument indicating the owner ID of the blockage.
Default is nil.

items.desc: When successful, the blockage database ID is returned.
nil is returned if the cellview ID is invalid.

returns.text:
d_areaBlockageId
When successful, the blockage database ID is returned.
nil
nil is returned if the cellview ID is invalid.

decl.text:
dbCreateAreaBoundary(
d_cellviewIdl_points
[ t_name = nil] [ lt_edgeNames = nil]
)
=> d_areaBoundaryId / nil

description.text:
Creates an area boundary object in the specified cellview.
An area boundary specifies an area in a block for a specific purpose. Area boundaries are named. A block can have multiple area boundaries, each identified by its name.

items.name: d_cellviewId
items.desc: The database ID of the cellview.

items.name: l_points
items.desc:
Specifies the list of points for the boundary.
For more information, see Type l_point.

items.name: t_name
items.desc: Optional argument that specifies the name of the area boundary.

items.name: lt_edgeNames
items.desc: Optional argument that list the names of boundary edges.

arguments.text:
d_cellviewId
The database ID of the cellview.
l_points
Specifies the list of points for the boundary.
For more information, see Type l_point.
t_name
Optional argument that specifies the name of the area boundary.
lt_edgeNames
Optional argument that list the names of boundary edges.

items.desc: Returns the database ID of the boundary if the creation is successful.
nil is returned if the cellview ID is invalid.

returns.text:
d_areaBoundaryId
Returns the database ID of the boundary if the creation is successful.
nil
nil is returned if the cellview ID is invalid.

decl.text:
dbCreateAreaHalo(
d_ownerIdn_topOffset
n_bottomOffset
n_leftOffset
n_rightOffset
)=> d_areaHaloId / nil

description.text:
Creates an areaHalo blockage object of type placement. An area halo is associated with an instance or a prBoundary to represent an extended area around the master's prBoundary.
An area halo supports four offsets which extend the area around a instance or a prBoundary in four orthogonal directions. The offsets in these directions can be different.

items.name: d_ownerId
items.desc: The owner ID of the areaHalo blockage.

items.name: n_topOffset
items.desc: Integer or floating-point number indicating the top offset of the area halo.

items.name: n_bottomOffset
items.desc: Integer or floating-point number indicating the bottom offset of the area halo.

items.name: n_leftOffset
items.desc: Integer or floating-point number indicating the left offset of the area halo.

items.name: n_rightOffset
items.desc: Integer or floating-point number indicating the right offset of the area halo.

arguments.text:
d_ownerId
The owner ID of the areaHalo blockage.
n_topOffset
Integer or floating-point number indicating the top offset of the area halo.
n_bottomOffset
Integer or floating-point number indicating the bottom offset of the area halo.
n_leftOffset
Integer or floating-point number indicating the left offset of the area halo.
n_rightOffset
Integer or floating-point number indicating the right offset of the area halo.

items.desc: When successful, the area halo database ID is returned.
nil is returned if the cellview ID is invalid.

returns.text:
d_areaHaloId
When successful, the area halo database ID is returned.
nil
nil is returned if the cellview ID is invalid.
